candidate.answerReason: At constant speed 300 km/h, distance equals 300 times time, so t=s/300.

methods.label: Use the distance–speed–time relationship
methods.explanation: Time = distance ÷ speed. When the speed is fixed, \(t=s/300\), so t is directly proportional to s. Option B reverses the positions of speed and distance.
methods.levelReason: The explanation uses an elementary travel relationship and direct proportion.
